l1: Turn your wedding photos into a reel. Just tap Reel Edits.
l2: Swipe through the styles. Each one has its own music and motion.
l3: Found one you love? Tap, use template.
l4: Your photos from Find me are already in.
l5: Want your own photos or videos too? Add them from your phone.
l6: Press play. Every cut lands on the beat.
l7: Add your names, a drawing, a filter, or change the song.
l8: Tap Next. Your reel is made right on your phone.
l9: Then share it on Instagram or WhatsApp.
l10: PicGrades. Your wedding, in your own app.
